science.question: Does evaluating the original curved-P2 constitutive tensor at each cell's ten native nodes retain useful intra-element variation lost by fourQ cell-mean recovery, for supervised original signed scalar S?
science.scope: One full-FE representation pair on existing TRAIN3/DEV2/ver; not a final solver selection, original H3D recovery or pointcloud-only architecture ranking.
science.immutable_U: Both reuse the same original zero-start true-converged FP64 physical_u_mm.npy; persist original U by byte copy and verify file/value identity, no normalized-FP32 roundtrip and no new GT-U metric.

representation.node_order: Existing cells10 is VTK order: corners0,1,2,3; mids(0,1),(1,2),(2,0),(0,3),(1,3),(2,3), from accepted GRID-aligned cache, never GRID_ID-1 or coordinate reassignment.
representation.physical_gradient: J[c,r]=sum_a X_a,c dN_a/dr_r at each of all10 native barycentric nodes; solve J^T grad_X_N_a=grad_r_N_a in FP64. G_i,j=sum_a U_a,i grad_X_j N_a. No straight-corner, P1, fourQ extrapolation or normalized-coordinate derivative.
representation.tensor: epsilon=(G+G^T)/2; sigma=2mu epsilon+lambda tr(epsilon)I. Slots xx,yy,zz,xy,xz,yz use tensor shear, not engineering shear.
representation.aggregation: For node n, sum incident cell w_c*sigma_c(local node n) / sum incident w_c, fixed positive w_c=V_c/10 and V_c=sum accepted fourQ physical weights. This is the only selected aggregation; no region/material/scalar/sign sweep.
representation.baseline: Reuse immutable accepted fourQ-cellmean→same incident V_c/10 sigma_MPa.npy + valid.npy. No old recovery rerun. Train a fresh matched7-dimensional head, do not reuse the old67-dimensional endpoint.
representation.valid: Mass>0 coverage must exactly equal accepted old validity. Missing incident nodes retain valid0/zero slots explicitly; any reached singular/nonfinite node Jacobian invalidates the whole candidate, never disguise it as a missing node or drop a cell.
representation.precision: FP64 CUDA field/Jacobian/constitutive/reduction; native all10 mapped physical evaluation; persist aggregated N×6, validity and small guard/memory/cost manifests only.
representation.claim: An explicitly chosen geometry/constitutive proxy. Neither representation is asserted to be the original source solver's GPSTRESS/H3D/CSV exporter recovery or signed scalar formula.

normalization.tensor6: For each representation independently, fit FP64 six means/population std on valid original TRAIN3 nodes only; std floor1e-8 MPa; force invalid normalized slots0. Persist both records before either arm trains, no DEV fit.
normalization.signed_S: Reuse exact accepted TRAIN3-only signed-asinh scaler and provenance; (asinh(S/scale_MPa)-mean)/std. No new output fit or DEV information.

neural.model: Fresh MLP7->64 ReLU->64 ReLU->1 direct unbounded encoded signed-S output; input only normalized tensor6+valid1. No xyz/cloud/25, global encoder, q*tanh, hand sign or external weights.
neural.identical_initialization: Instantiate common head once and clone exact trainable state into both fresh arms before any update; save identity metadata. No historical pretrained endpoint.
neural.model_precision: FP32 with TF32, no autocast; inverse signed-asinh decoding FP64 original MPa.
neural.batch: Each update is one full original TRAIN CAD. Sum squared encoded-S error/N across all node chunks, backward each weighted chunk, one Adam update. This is a new frozen7-head fullN exposure pair, not a historical7-head reproduction.
neural.first_real_update: Finite fullN loss and finite present active head gradients with nonzero total gradient norm; actual first frozen training update, no separate preflight.
neural.fixed_endpoint: Both exact120 endpoints only; no validation selection, extra step/seed/width/loss/normalizer/aggregation rescue.

label_access.barrier: Persist both arms' allN original-row-order DEV2 signed-S predictions and exact original U outputs before either cached DEV S member is read; shared DEV read once/case, then fixed metrics.
label_access.no_new_solve_recovery_or_labels: New tensor recovery5 is explicitly allowed; new physical solves0, K applications0, old guards0, source strain GT0, canonical source S0, displacement target0, sealed/final/dia0.
label_access.actual_receipts: Count real attempts/completed cache-member/physical-U/tensor/valid/TRAIN-S/DEV-S reads, two TRAIN tensor fits, actual optimizer updates/checkpoint writes/own reads; forbidden counts native int0. Do not label cached supervision as GT-free.
label_access.resume: Own committed prediction/scaler/tensor/label cache reuse; no repeat source label reads. Technical repair only with cumulative failed wall preserved, never restart science or retune.

metrics_and_gates.hotspot: ceil(1%N) largest absolute original signed-S GT; descending abs then ascending original row stable tie rule; relative energy zero gives null and no automatic gate pass.
metrics_and_gates.complete_service_accuracy_gate: Both new element-node DEV signed-S relativeL2 and hotspot relativeL2 strictly<0.25, both arms complete120/allN/barrier/valid receipts.
metrics_and_gates.representation_gain_gate: Additionally element-node mean signed-S relativeL2 reduction>=20% vs matched fresh fourQ-cellmean arm; positive finite denominator required; each DEV S relativeL2 and hotspot relativeL2<=1.05×matched baseline. No comparison to unmatched historical67-head for this gate.
metrics_and_gates.partial_positive: If only representation gain passes, record improved recovery information but still incomplete GeoBC signed-S service; no final solver selection.
metrics_and_gates.negative: Close this one frozen node-tensor representation if geometry/coverage/budget/accuracy/gain fails. No other aggregation, scalar/sign formula, seed/width/loss/steps or node/P1 rescue.

budgets.ledger: New compact deterministic phase/case/arm/step cursor, ~60s or completedCAD/fullpass/checkpoint/barrier/failure journals. All metadata/cache IO/H2D/Jacobian/recovery/scalers/training/checkpoint/model/input/inference/decode/persist/metrics/failed/resume wall charged; original inherited costs once. No parent Clock/run or budget reset. Unknown process-exit gap conservatively counted until observed exit evidence. Float ledger consistency uses1e-8 tolerance.
budgets.checkpoints: Own model+Adam+full RNG+exact ordered-pass cursor/clocks at completed fullCAD boundaries about60s and endpoint/failure, no per-step large history rewrite. No replay of a completed arm or committed predictions.
budgets.budget_negative: Missing either fixed120 endpoint/fullN barrier is terminal budget-negative, not model-accuracy failure. Never read DEV labels to score a partial unpaired endpoint.

cost_report.campaign: Original physics inherited once + accepted baseline4Q recovery/validity inherited once + new actual paired stage; one-off training/scalers/metric labels separate.
cost_report.fourQ_arm_deployment: Per CAD original GT-free physics + old accepted4Q recovery/validity + measured incremental head input/model load/fullN inference/decode/persist. Excludes new node recovery.
cost_report.node_arm_deployment: Per CAD original GT-free physics + measured new full10 physical-gradient/tensor/aggregation/input/persist + head input/model load/fullN inference/decode/persist. Do not add old4Q tensor recovery to node arm; accepted quadrature weight cache/source attribution remains explicit.
cost_report.cost_claim: Composed accounted cold with historical original setup/input/operator receipts, not fresh combined cold; cached latency separately measured, never splice faster newer coarse solver cost or call historical caches free.
